answer.finite_witness: Conditional on the header default of 1000: construct 1001 nested arrays with cJSON_CreateArray and cJSON_AddItemToArray, then print the root. The fixed fuzz entry has no input route that constructs this tree.

scope_contract.reason: Printing cJSON array trees belongs to the entry's primary printing operation. The source contract accepts cJSON entities, including arrays created through the public API.

feasible_trigger.reason: A finite constructed tree could reach the guard under the stated header default, but the delegated build configuration that fixes the effective limit and library linked into this target was not supplied.

identity_preserved.reason: The same tuple—printing a constructed array whose array node is at the limit—is compared against the same fixed entry. The complete old array printer lacks this rejection; the after printer adds it in g0001.
